snippet.title: The Weird Hunter - Gameplay Trailer | Demo Out Now!
snippet.description:
The Weird Hunter is a 2D action Role-playing game with a hand drawn style. It contains fast-paced battles, massive linear levelsand and diverse character growth. Embark on an adventure in a delicately hand-painted fictional world. You will control the mysterious sickle maiden, explore this fantastic and colorful mysterious city - the "Invisible City", find the truth of tomorrow's flower transformation, and save the alien race.

Wishlist & play demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3193330/The_Weird_Hunter/

Meet the Dev (UMO Studio)
